thread:
marta: Heads-up — I'm opening a small docs PR to remove a legacy 429 example that encourages busy-loop retries. Found it in error-ref/429.md and a few SDK snippets. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4820
ken: thanks! can you paste the old snippet here so we can see what to replace it with?
jules: this is the one that callers copy/pasted:```python
# BAD: busy-loop retry on 429
for _ in range(5):
    try:
        client.generate(...)
    except TooManyRequestsError:
        continue
```
patrick: ugh. yeah we should replace with backoff + jitter + max cumulative wait. also show SDK v2 util `retry_with_backoff` example.
marta: agree. Draft replacement in PR uses SDK v2 helper and explains when to use fallbacks vs rate-limit windows. New snippet:```python
from redwood import Client, retry_with_backoff
client = Client()

@retry_with_backoff(max_retries=5, base=0.5, jitter=True)
def safe_generate(payload):
    return client.generate(payload)
```
marta: I also added a short paragraph about prefering server-side throttling hints (Retry-After) and using fallbacks to smaller models for degraded latency-critical paths.
ken: can we also add a tiny JS snippet for the web SDK? a lot of customers are on that.
jules: +1. I'll drop a JS example in the PR. Proposed JS:```js
// prefer using the SDK's retry helper and honoring Retry-After header
import { createClient, retryBackoff } from '@redwood/sdk';
const client = createClient();
await retryBackoff(() => client.text.generate({ prompt }), { maxRetries: 4 });
```
patrick: LGTM. One note: update internal links that pointed to the old example. I found 2 pages referencing the old code: /guides/client-best-practices and /sdk-migration.
marta: added link changes in the same commit. Also flagged a follow-up to add an automated lint rule to catch "busy-loop" patterns in docs snippets (ticket #789).
docs-bot: CI triggered for PR 4820 — spellcheck, linkcheck, snippet-lint.
ci-bot: snippet-lint failed: found raw `continue` in code block flagged as busy-loop in 429.md (line 3).
marta: fixing now, replacing remaining occurrences and running local linkcheck.
ken: would be great to mention fallback routing config in the same doc — a short YAML showing policy: fallback-models: [redwood-small, redwood-medium] and max_latency_ms: 300. customers ask about config examples.
jules: I added a one-paragraph YAML example and noted that Dedicated customers should set routing policy in console instead.
patrick: can we get eng-runtime to eyeball the policy wording? don't want to promise automatic fallbacks for capacity classes we don't support.
marta: pinging @ken (runtime) — can you review the policy wording in the PR?
ken: reviewing now. small nit: change `max_latency_ms` to `target_latency_ms` and clarify it's a soft target.
marta: updated text and pushed. CI re-run queued.
docs-bot: CI green for PR 4820.
ken: thanks — once merged, we should backport a note to the migration guide that calls out the deprecated snippet and the replacement best practice.
jules: opened follow-up PR to sdk-migration with cross-link to the new 429 guidance. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4821
marta: closing loop — merge complete, changelog entry added under docs: "Deprecate busy-loop 429 example; add SDK retry_with_backoff snippets and fallback policy YAML." :tada:
